description.line3: Software Craftsmanship advocate: TDD, DDD, pair programming.

paragraphs.p1: Passionate developer with over 15 years of experience in IT, I transitioned to development {years} years ago, driven by my passion for digital and discovering code and Software Craftsmanship best practices.
paragraphs.p2: My unique journey, starting as a helpdesk technician and evolving into system and network administration, has given me a holistic view of information systems. This experience enriches my development practice, allowing me to approach projects as a whole, from infrastructure to code.
paragraphs.p3: As a freelancer, I particularly focus on Clean Code principles and craft development practices. I firmly believe that code quality and long-term maintainability are as important as immediate functionality.
paragraphs.p4: My dual technical expertise — infrastructure and development — allows me to bring unique added value to projects, combining technical robustness and code excellence.

mgm.title: MyGameMobile
mgm.shortDescription: 10K monthly users — the store's daily brief, in one place
mgm.description: Department managers could only read their performance on desktop, inside other applications. MyGameMobile made it readable on mobile, then went past reading to help them decide. A second persona followed: the Captain, the store's referent for the day, who runs the morning brief with the department managers. What that brief needed was scattered across several applications and copied out by hand; it is now gathered in one place, money time included, the decisive stretches of the day when teams have to be on the floor. The time saved turned into payroll: up to €100,000 a year across Switzerland. I owned the product and acted as the link between stakeholders. 10,000 users a month, worldwide.

fcs.title: Famille Client Satisfait
fcs.shortDescription: 5K monthly users — 20 questions that shape the shelf
fcs.description: Self-assessment for department managers: around twenty questions on the state of the aisles, the assortments and stock accuracy, everything that ends up showing on the shelf. Each family sets its own cadence, from weekly to monthly. Favourable answers and the actions that follow raise the satisfaction score. 5,000 users a month, worldwide.

stic.title: Transverse Cycle Identification Solution
stic.shortDescription: 1.4M bikes a year, €38 fine per miss — shipped in 3 months
stic.description: French law requires every bicycle sold to be marked, under a €38 fine per bike. Decathlon sells 1.4 million a year, and the app had three months to ship with no right to fail. Everything hinged on how smooth the pairing was: a shop assistant's time is short, and the customer in front of them should not pay for it. Embedded QR code scanner. 2,000 users a day, in France.

winky.title: Winkyverse
winky.shortDescription: Front-end of the largest French ICO of 2021 — €24.5M raised
winky.description: Sale platform for the Winkyverse ICO, the educational metaverse built by the startup Mainbot. My scope: front-end integration and the move to responsive, from desktop to mobile. The ICO raised €24.5M, the largest French raise of 2021.

mechachain.title: Mechachain
mechachain.shortDescription: Front-end of an ICO sale platform — play-to-earn mecha game
mechachain.description: Sale platform for the Mechachain ICO, the play-to-earn mecha game by EthernalHorizons. The same exercise as the Winkyverse in the same year, and the same scope: front-end integration and the move to responsive. 10,000 buyers.

mc.title: Managers Companion
mc.shortDescription: Agentic AI layer — the app absorbing MyGameMobile and the rest
mc.description: Decathlon had accumulated applications that often answered the same business domain. Managers Companion brings them together, and MyGameMobile was the first one absorbed. The scope reaches further: commercial policy, self-assessment. AI was an explicit requirement, both a showcase of what the team can deliver and a way to exploit analytical power fed by the data and the algorithms the existing applications had already proven. I integrated an AI layer under an agentic architecture.

highlights: Same client since 2021, across three successive scopes
